'''Eamul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Minister/Legends|Minister]] of the [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorran]] government during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]] Eamul and other Balmorran officials-in-exile were invited by [[Tai Cordan]] to join with a [[Balmorran resistance]] cell led by a revolutionary named [[Zenith]] as they were about to rescue the [[President/Legends|President]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] [[Retheus Galthe]]. Unfortunately, prolonged torture by [[Darth Lachris]] broke Galthe's mind and a [[Balmorra citizens committee]] was assembled by Eamul and other Balmorrans to oversee the transfer of political power to Tai Cordan.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Minister Eamul appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Consular class mission on Balmorra.
